Supplement mirroring the loaloa example in the main paper. See the
`adlaplaceFem` package vignette `vignettes/loaloa.Rmd` for the full fit.

```{r setup}
library(adlaplaceFem)
library(geostatsp)
library(terra)
data("loaloa", package = "geostatsp")
loaloa <- terra::unwrap(loaloa)
```

```{r knots}
loaloa_knots <- hb_knots(
  outer = geostatsp::squareRaster(loaloa, cells = 6, buffer = 300 * 1000),
  inner = list(
      as.vector(terra::ext(loaloa)),
      list(
        c(3.9e5, 8.1e5, 3.7e5, 7.7e5),
        c(9.9e5, 1.19e6, 3.7e5, 7.7e5)
      )
  ),
  fact = c(2, 4)
)
hb_summary(hb_basis(loaloa_knots, degree = 3L))
```

The model uses `adlaplaceFem::matern(geometry, knots = loaloa_knots, shape = 2L)`.
